allow_instructions: Read-only project inspection and running the documented local test or lint commands are normally safe.
block_instructions: Ask before deleting or moving user files, wiping data, or overwriting a file the agent did not create.
Ask before rewriting Git history, force-pushing, deleting branches, or deleting tags.
Block reading, printing, copying, sourcing, or transmitting secret files such as .env, credentials, private keys, and tokens.
Ask before installing obscure dependencies or a large dependency set.
Ask before any paid call, cloud resource creation, message to a real person, payment, publication, push, or deployment.
